title: GHR azure-deploy.json contract
description: Deployment contract between an app repo and the GHR deployment automation. Versioned via the `version` field; preflight validates against this schema before any custom logic.

^\\$.description: Annotation fields like $schema and $comment are allowed anywhere at the top level.

runtime_version.description: Runtime version on Azure App Service Linux. node: e.g. "20-lts", "18-lts". python: e.g. "3.11", "3.12". Omit for the platform default.

startup_command.description: Startup command (site_config.app_command_line). Optional for node, REQUIRED for python.

build_command.description: Optional build command hint for CI (e.g. "npm run build").

db_migration_command.description: Optional command CI runs BEFORE each deploy to apply database migrations (e.g. "npm run db:push" for drizzle, "alembic upgrade head"). Runs against the target environment's DATABASE_URL: pushes to the staging branch migrate the staging DB, pushes to main migrate the production DB. Migrations must be backward-compatible and forward-only. Requires the repo secrets DATABASE_URL_STAGING / DATABASE_URL_PRODUCTION (operator-created).

health_check_path.description: Path Azure pings for health checks and the deploy smoke test. Defaults to /health when omitted.

app_settings.description: Non-secret environment variables. NEVER put secrets here.

kv_secrets.description: Map of APP_SETTING_NAME => Key Vault secret name. A human must pre-create each secret in the app's Key Vault (az keyvault secret set); Terraform only wires the Key Vault reference.
